images.screen: A · 어둠 속 — 불을 켜지 않아야만 거기 있는 사람
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame: a single quiet room at night painted in a Hammershoi-like muted oil-painting style with soft brush texture and canvas grain, 16:9. Deep blue-green darkness, a tall six-pane window on the right letting in cold moonlight that falls as a pale parallelogram on old floorboards, grey wainscot panels along the wall, a small side table with a teacup. In the center an old armchair catches the moonlight, and in it sits a woman who is only a pure black silhouette in side profile, hair in a low bun, facing the window, a thin cold rim light tracing her face, chest and knee, her breath faintly visible. Minimal HUD in a delicate serif: a line of her whispered dialogue at the bottom center, a thin breathing waveform bottom-left, a small hold-to-light button bottom-right. Melancholic, tender, still. Korean UI text: "그녀는 불을 켜지 않으면 거기 있다", "세 걸음", "손전등".

images.screen: B · 비춘 순간 — 빛을 비추자 비어 버린 의자
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame: the same painterly room, but a warm golden flashlight pool now floods the armchair from the viewer's position, revealing warm ochre upholstery, a soft dent still pressed into the seat cushion and a rust-red fringed shawl slipping off one arm. The chair is empty. At the edge of the light, a faint dotted pale-blue afterimage outline of the seated woman is dissolving into drifting ash-like particles, while golden dust motes float in the beam. The rest of the room falls into heavier darkness, the moonlit window now dim. Soft oil-paint texture, film grain, strong chiaroscuro, grief and absence. Minimal serif HUD: a caption line at the bottom, a small top-right counter showing how long she was seen, the flashlight button lit warm gold. Korean UI text: "비추는 순간, 없었다", "0.4초". Composition constraints: the flashlight beam visibly starts at the bottom edge of the frame and points forward into the scene, landing squarely on the armchair; it must not point sideways or toward the viewer. The room is the same sparse Hammershoi room as before (six-pane window on the right, grey wainscot, small side table with a teacup, bare floorboards), with no bookshelves, busts, portraits or clutter. The afterimage woman sits facing the window with empty hands (no book). The top-right counter label reads exactly "보인 시간" above "0.4초".
